note: Union County Conservation Board, 1 mi SW of Thayer on a 10-acre lake built by the railroad in the 1850s. 8 electric campsites around the lakeside parking area by the boat ramp and shelter, plus primitive sites. Rocked access road off Hwy 34 through native timber. --Claude
summary: County page confirms 8 electric sites + primitive, pit latrine, boat ramp, shelter on a 10-acre lake; county FAQ makes all Union CCB camping FCFS. No Thayer camping rate published (the FAQ's $22/$32 is Three Mile Lake's). Lakeview kept (parking lot and ramp between pads and water). PIN ~450 m off on the rail line.
flags: PIN MOVE: stored 41.02300,-94.06850 is on the railroad north-west of the lake, ~450 m from the campground. Esri shows the lakeside gravel parking area, boat ramp and shelter at the lake's south-east corner, ~41.0209,-94.0640. Re-pin there.

WATERFRONT: lakeview kept. The sites ring the gravel lot; the lot itself and the boat ramp (day use) lie between the pads and the water, ~30-60 m across open gravel to the shore. Open view, but day use between, so not lakefront. Lake is 10 acres per the county (over the 5-acre pond line).

NO RATE: no Thayer Lake camping fee is posted. The county FAQ's '$22 per night for sites with electric hook-ups (74 sites) and $32 per night at full service sites' describes Three Mile Lake (74 electric sites, full service), not Thayer; not applied. A Good Sam listing says 'From $8 / night' (aggregator). Fees left empty.
